spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (अर्व्वति)
To kill or hurt, also written अर्ब्ब.

n. (-टं)
Ashes.
E.
अर्व्व or अर्ब्ब to injure, hence the word may be also written अर्ब्बट.

mfn. (-र्व्वा-र्व्वती-र्व्वत्)
Low, inferior, vile.
m. (-र्व्वा)
1 A horse.
2 A name of

A short span.
f. (-र्वती)
1 A mare.
2 A bawd, a procuress.
E.
ऋ to go, and वनिप् Uṇādi affix; it is sometimes derived from अर्ब्ब to go, and is then written अर्ब्बन्.

mfn. (-वाङ्-वाची-वाक्)
Following, subsequent.
ind. (वाच् or वाक्)
1 After, in time.
2 Behind, in place.
3 Near.
E.
अवर behind, अञ्च to go, and क्विप् affix; the formation is irregular.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Reverse, contrary.
2 Recent, modern.
E.
अर्व्वाच् and ख aff.

n. (-त्वं)
State of reverse.
E.
त्व added to the last; also with तल्, अर्व्वाचीनता.

ind.
1 After, afterwards.
2 Behind.
E.
अर्व्वाक् and अण् pleonastic aff.
